newsitem.title: UK: Higher Chicago futures lift Euro veg oils at close.
newsitem.headline: Higher Chicago futures lift Euro veg oils at close.

text.p: Higher Chicago soy oil futures gave the European vegetable oil some late support on Wednesday.
Palm oil prices closed off their lows for the day while soft oils posted further small gains.
Earlier palm oil had slipped following liquidation by players in Asia ahead of the expected release on Thursday of Ivan Wong's latest Malaysian crop report.
Traders said players in the Far East did not want to be caught with large positions in case Wong's report was bearish.
Crude palm oil cif Europe closed $2.50 down to unchanged in a tradeless market.
Refined palm oil finished with RBD oil unchanged and olein $5 to $2.50 lower with no further business reported during the afternoon.
Coconut oil closed unchanged to $10 down while palmkernel oil was $5 up after Dec, Jan and Mar all traded at $710 a tonne cif.
Traders reported active trading in soy oil during the afternoon with some consumer buying seen.
Dutch soy oil traded at 86 guilders for Nov, 86.50 for Dec and 90 guilders for Feb/Apr per 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Rape oil fetched 92 guilders for Nov/Jan.
Closing soy oil sellers were unchanged to 0.75 guilders up and rape oil 1.50 to one guilder higher.
Based on sellers' prices the closing premium for rape oil over soy oil was 3.75 to 5.5 guilders against 3.50 to four guilders at Tuesday's close. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8062
